name: traceroute
description: Print the route packets take to network host

name: --help
-h
options.description: Show help for traceroute

name: -a
options.description: Turn on AS# lookups for each hop encountered

name: -A
options.description: Turn on AS# lookups and use the given server instead of the default

name: -d
options.description: Enable socket level debugging

name: -D
options.description: When an ICMP response to our probe datagram is received, print the differences between the transmitted packet…

name: -e
options.description: Firewall evasion mode

name: -f
options.description: Set the initial time-to-live used in the first outgoing probe packet

name: -F
options.description: Set the `don't fragment` bit

name: -g
options.description: Specify a loose source route gateway (8 maximum)

name: -i
options.description: Specify a network interface to obtain the source IP address for outgoing probe packets

name: -I
options.description: Use ICMP ECHO instead of UDP datagrams

name: -M
options.description: Set the initial time-to-live value used in outgoing probe packets

name: -m
options.description: Set the max time-to-live (max number of hops) used in outgoing probe packets

name: -n
options.description: Print hop addresses numerically rather than symbolically and numerically (saves a nameserver address-to-name…

name: -P
options.description: Send packets of specified IP protocol

name: -p
options.description: Protocol specific. For UDP and TCP, sets the base port number used in probes (default is 33434). traceroute h…

name: -q
options.description: Set the number of probes per ``ttl'' to nqueries (default is three probes)

name: -r
options.description: Bypass the normal routing tables and send directly to a host on an attached network

name: -s
options.description: Use the following IP address (which must be given as an IP number, not a hostname) as the source address in o…

name: -S
options.description: Print a summary of how many probes were not answered for each hop

name: -t
options.description: Set the type-of-service in probe packets to the following value (default zero)

name: -v
options.description: Verbose output. Received ICMP packets other than TIME_EXCEEDED and UNREACHABLEs are listed

name: -w
options.description: Set the time (in seconds) to wait for a response to a probe (default 5 sec.)

name: -x
options.description: Toggle IP checksums. Normally, this prevents traceroute from calculating IP checksums. In some cases, the ope…

name: -z
options.description: Set the time (in milliseconds) to pause between probes (default 0)
